title: The Fall Guy
tagline: Stunts all day, prawns by the harbour.
about: A battered stuntman is pulled back onto a film set in Sydney to find the movie's missing star.
cue: Serve the prawns when Colt takes the big fall in the opening stunt.
faces: Two coffees, one lunch, and yes, I'm doing the jump myself again. Don't tell the director.
